title: Historic Austin: Dam Project, Taxes, Pauper Care
summary:
*   **Segregated Public Services:** Approved various city contracts, notably separate bids for handling "white pauper remains" and "colored pauper remains," along with general city and hospital supplies.
*   **Major Infrastructure Update:** Extended the deadline for the dam reconstruction contractor due to a city-mandated change in the power transmission line route; also officially set new street grades for Baylor Street.
*   **Property Tax & Charity Policy:** Authorized a deal to clear delinquent property taxes by transferring city liens in exchange for full payment; and allocated $750 from the general fund to charity.
